note: Nigeria: nationals of the ECOWAS states (with Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger), Cameroon, Chad, Saint Kitts and Nevis and Seychelles enter without a visa for 90 days; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 1 May 2025; processed in 48 hours, USD 50 to 300). Every visitor needs a landing card before departure (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Nigeria
sources.said: Visitors to Nigeria require a visa unless they come from one of the visa-exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following countries may enter Nigeria without a visa for up to 90 days: All ECOWAS member states Burkina Faso Cameroon Chad Mali Niger Saint Kitts and Nevis Seychelles ... Nigeria introduced an e-Visa system on 1 May 2025, granting non-renewable short-term visas across various categories, including business and tourism, with a stated processing time of 48 hours.
